nalli:10605808451883.description: Mugdha, a Muppagam Kanjeevaram with a quietly captivating presence, brings together deep Kanchana, Arakku and off-white in a striking kattam design. The borders and body are joined using the Korvai technique, with temple motifs at the joineries. Vanki, Rudraksha and Kamalam motifs enrich the borders, while the Petni pallu features traditional Seepu Reku, fine temples woven in gold zari.
tags: Koadu Kattam and Half & Half - Half Fine/Without Zari

nalli:10605821657387.description: Vasavi, rooted in tradition, finds expression in a Kanjeevaram with two grand Muhurtham Konia butas featuring delicate Kuthirai motifs, open-winged Mayil and florals. The rich Ghetti border brings together a horse mother-and-child motif with traditional florals, separated by rows of Thuthripoo pet. The floral vine continues into the pallu, forming the Konia buta, while the Kuthirai border is echoed in a broad twill Ghetti.

nalli:10605809008939.description: Vaanya, inspired by the goddess of the forest, brings the beauty of nature into a richly woven Kanjeevaram. The brocade body features traditional Zari Kattam, with geometric square sections framed by floral details. Each section is centred with a Killi motif and accented by delicate Kamalam butas. The borders combine bold Banaras or twill with fine silk stripes, while the pallu carries forward the same Banaras twill and floral geometry of the body. Vaanya captures the essence of nature through c

nalli:10605808615723.description: Rithi, reflecting prosperity and abundance, comes alive in a Kanjeevaram where a brocade composition flows from the pallu towards the hip, creating a graceful half-and-half effect when draped. A dense chevron pattern defines the front fall, while delicate butas across the pleats keep the design balanced. The border carries the chevron motif forward, bringing continuity to the saree.

nalli:10605807141163.description: Parijata, a cream and off-white Kanjeevaram with pastel pink borders and pallu, is named after the celestial tree of mythology. The pallu features rich brocade followed by a row of large Manga motifs, while the borders carry intricate floral patterns topped with zari temples. Small floral butis across the body echo the borders and pallu, creating continuity throughout the saree.

nalli:10605807337771.description: Shreeja, a name associated with creativity, finds expression in a Mubaggam Kanchipuram silk saree with an Elakkai-coloured body scattered with evenly spaced Mayil buttas in golden zari. Broad pink and orange brocade sections feature a continuous foliage pattern, while narrow twill bands define the transition. The contrast pallu brings together decorative stripes, Veldhari, zari bands and a central zari panel.

nalli:10605807272235.description: Vijaya, reflecting victory and the strength of the Gandaberunda, finds expression in pure mulberry silk Kanjeevaram with golden zari. Its broad border features the ornamental Gandaberunda and hand-stitched Killi motifs, above fine zari stripes, Kamalam pet and Kuyilkann pet. The body carries finely woven Killi motifs, while the bold pallu continues the saree's design language with dense brocade.

The border pairs Kamalam butas with the traditional Mayilkann motif, while the dense Ghetti pallu brings both elements together. A distinctive weave defined by thoughtful geometry and intricate detail.

nalli:10578452578603.description:
This striking pink tissue-brocade saree resembles liquid gold with hints of pink at first glance. A closer inspection reveals the finer details that make up this opulent Banarasi saree. 
The borders feature an undulating floral bel or vine, and a delicate all-over floral brocade with leaves and flower buds adorn the body. The pallu is distinguised from the body by its densely woven geometric design. The saree is framed by thin selvedges on either side, lending a subtle accent in rose-pink.

nalli:10578452545835.description:
This delicate Kora saree in light teal is woven in Banaras in the kadhua technique with each motif in the body woven individually in gold zari. 
It features borders with floral vines, framing the body, which in turn contains tiny floral butis, which appear to be afloat on the sheer fabric. The pallu is intricate and dense, featuring large floral butas placed within ornamental niches. This is further enclosed within additional floral cross-borders, bringing the composition together cohesively.
